name: Kamala Harris

lean.basis: Democratic district attorney, California attorney general, senator, vice president (2021–2025) and 2024 presidential nominee.

race_2028.basis: Has led most national 2028 Democratic primary polls since spring 2026 and has hired staff, met donors and traveled to battleground states, though she says she is undecided and many former aides doubt she will run.

current_role: Former Vice President of the United States (2021–2025); head of the Fight for the People PAC
summary: Kamala Harris was San Francisco district attorney, California attorney general and a U.S. senator before serving as vice president under Joe Biden from 2021 to 2025. She became the Democratic nominee after Biden withdrew in 2024 and lost to Donald Trump. She leads many 2028 primary polls and has kept a political operation through her Fight for the People PAC, but has not decided whether to run.
